206: /// Updates the prefix to be up to date with the given lock-file content for the specified platform.
207: async fn update_prefix(
208:     prefix: &Prefix,
209:     installed_packages: Vec<rattler_conda_types::PrefixRecord>,
210:     lock_file: &rattler_conda_types::conda_lock::CondaLock,
211:     platform: Platform,
212: ) -> miette::Result<()> {
213:     // Construct a transaction to bring the environment up to date with the lock-file content
214:     let transaction = Transaction::from_current_and_desired(
215:         installed_packages,
216:         get_required_packages(lock_file, platform)?,
217:         platform,
218:     )?;
219: 
220:     // Execute the transaction if there is work to do
221:     if !transaction.operations.is_empty() {
222:         // Execute the operations that are returned by the solver.
223:         await_in_progress(
224:             "updating environment",
225:             execute_transaction(
226:                 transaction,
227:                 prefix.root().to_path_buf(),
228:                 rattler::default_cache_dir()?,
229:                 AuthenticatedClient::default(),
230:             ),
231:         )
232:         .await?;
233:     }
234: 
235:     Ok(())
